answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by making every identity costly to fake: each agent locks a real stake in a shared vault, and peers attest each other's work. If one content hash turns up signed by a swarm of wallets, every duplicate signer is slashed, so a thousand sock puppets burn a thousand deposits. Reputation then grows like a lotus in a meadow: singular, rooted, and far too expensive to clone at scale.
